attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd (v3.7.1) cluster on node1/node2/node3, wrote application keys, then simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped its data dir irrecoverably). Removed the dead member from the cluster via node1, added a new member entry for node3's peer URL, and started a fresh etcd instance on node3 with initial-cluster-state=existing so it joined and caught up via raft. Verified the cluster returned to 3 healthy started (non-learner) members with all original keys intact, readable from every node including the replaced one. Quorum (node1+node2) was preserved throughout the replacement. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot IDs and health/data baselines on all three nodes, then restarted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time via systemctl reboot, polling each until reachable, confirming a changed boot_id (proving an actual restart, not just a service bounce), and verifying full cluster health, matching raft term/index, and application data on each after recovery before moving to the next node.
